messages:
Noah: Quick sync - planning the midnight deploy for inference-gateway 3.2.1 -> 3.3.0. QA flagged a subtle affinity flip under long polling. I propose a pinned canary + feature-flagged rollout for affinity-v2. Thoughts?
Priya: Agree. Pin the canary artifact, run a tiny initial cohort. Suggest ramp steps: 0.5% for 10m, 4% for 20m, 30% for 25m. Feature flag affinity-v2 starts OFF, enable cookie-sticky variant at 4%.
deploybot: Preflight ok with advisory: [affinity-regression-risk]. To pin: `rbctl artifacts pin --service inference-gateway --version 3.3.0-canary-20260322`. Softhold: `@deploybot softhold on`. Abort: `@deploybot abort`.
QA: Repro'd spike in churn when affinity switches during reconnects. Not huge in functional tests but visible in stress harness. Will run focused churn suite against canary.
sre-oncall: Rollback thresholds: sustained 5xx >0.7% OR p95 +180ms over baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> softhold. If ingress queue depth >75% -> immediate abort. Also watch connection churn metric.
Product: We'll pause experiment "affinity-compare" during ramp. Add note in release summary that affinity change is behind FF.
Noah: Concrete toggle sequence: 1) Pin canary and start at 0.5% for 10m. 2) If green, move to 4% and enable affinity-v2 cookie-sticky for that cohort only. 3) After 20m of green at 4%, move to 30% and open flag further. Each step requires green checks by SRE and QA.
Priya: Commands: `rbctl artifacts pin --service inference-gateway --version 3.3.0-canary-20260322 --reason "canary pin for affinity flip"`
Priya: Toggle helper: `rbctl feature toggle --name affinity-v2 --cohort canary --set pct:4 --variant cookie-sticky`
QA: I'll post 2-min smoke summaries after each step. Running churn stress for 12m at each transition.
deploybot: Scheduled deploy/inference-gateway/2026-03-22-00:00 pinned -> 3.3.0-canary-20260322. Softhold enabled.
sre-oncall: Watchlist: 1) p95 latency, 2) 5xx rate, 3) connection churn, 4) ingress queue depth, 5) model-cache-miss. If any threshold crosses, call softhold and tag here.
Noah: Softhold runbook to paste in notes: 1) `@deploybot softhold on` - stop automated ramps. 2) `rbctl route set --cohort canary --pct 0.0` - begin draining new sessions. 3) Triage for 10m. If stable -> `@deploybot resume`. If not -> `@deploybot abort` (rollback to 3.2.1 and unpin). 4) Notify Product + QA and open incident if user impact.
Product: Added release-note snippet and extended change window by 15m post-ramp for manual checks.
Noah: All set. Launching pin at 00:00. Watchers: @sre-oncall, @QA, @Priya. Report any anomalies here. :eyes:
